scripts.clean: for dir in $(git ls-files '*/package.json' | xargs -n1 dirname); do pnpm --dir "$dir" run clean || exit 1; done && rm -rf node_modules/.cache
scripts.wipe: for dir in $(git ls-files '*/package.json' | xargs -n1 dirname); do pnpm --dir "$dir" run wipe || exit 1; done && rm -rf node_modules/.cache && pnpm purge
